meta.title: About LipoNexus | UC San Diego Spinout Commercializing MASLD Blood Test
meta.description: LipoNexus is a UC San Diego spinout developing best-in-class blood tests for Fatty Liver Disease and metabolic-associated diseases to improve patient care. Backed by decades of NIH investment.

hero.headline: A UC San Diego Spinout Commercializing Its First Test
hero.body: LipoNexus is commercializing best-in-class blood tests for Fatty Liver (MASLD/MASH) and metabolic-associated diseases to improve patient care. Co-founded by UC San Diego professors and physicians who are leaders in the fields of Lipidomics and Fatty Liver Disease, our technology is the product of decades of NIH investment and rigorous clinical science.

mission.headline: Our Mission
mission.body: To develop best-in-class blood tests for Fatty Liver and metabolic-associated diseases — enabling earlier diagnosis, better treatment decisions, and healthier outcomes for patients worldwide. We are offering a strategic investment opportunity to bring this breakthrough to the world.

approach.headline: Decades of NIH Investment Behind Our Technology
approach.body: The LipoNexus test was developed by a founder of the field of Lipidomics and is the product of decades of NIH investment. Our 15-lipid panel directly measures inflammatory lipid biomarkers — the root cause of MASLD — using commercial clinical laboratories and mass spectrometry.

points.title: $77M NIH Grant (2003–2013)
points.description: Established the field of Lipidomics via a National Institutes of Health 'Glue Grant' (U54 GM069338) for LIPID Metabolites And Pathways Strategy (LIPID MAPS®) — a multi-institutional initiative for detection, identification, and classification of all biological lipids.

points.title: $2M NIH Grant (2018–2024)
points.description: NIH Grant NIDDK 5 R01 DK105961 — 'Lipidomics Based Diagnostics for Nonalcoholic Steatohepatitis.' Lipidomics analysis of 2,000 biopsied patient samples from the NIDDK Biobank for development of MASLD and MASH diagnostics.

points.title: Clinical Validation
points.description: 500-patient clinical study published in October 2024. Current test IP filed in 2024 with 6 patents total (3 issued, 3 filed). 95%+ accuracy and 99% specificity validated against histological ground truth (liver biopsy).

points.title: Regulatory Pathway
points.description: Laboratory Developed Test (LDT) launch Q2 2026 — validation and verification in a CLIA lab. FDA-approved test targeted for 2027. Widespread clinician adoption 2028+ driven by hepatology clinical guideline recommendations.

items.title: Scientific Rigor
items.description: Every claim is backed by data — from $77M in NIH-funded research to a 500-patient published clinical study.

items.title: Patient Impact
items.description: Only 10% of people with Fatty Liver Disease are diagnosed. We exist to change that — by making accurate, non-invasive screening accessible to all.

items.title: Proactive Medicine
items.description: MASLD is often discovered only after disease progression. Routine, widely accessible non-invasive screening enables early detection and fully reverses the disease.

items.title: Collaboration
items.description: We partner with commercial labs, healthcare providers, and biopharma companies to maximize reach and impact across Medicine and Companion Diagnostics.
